snippet.title: Coming soon (Itch.io and The Meta Quest Store)
snippet.description:
#fearfactor #vr #teaser  #metagame #gtagfangame 

FearFactor Institute is a VR multiplayer horror game Set In the dark, industrial confines of an abandoned underground facility. Players find themselves trapped in a labyrinth of levels, with creatures, and mysterious mechanisms. Navigate the perilous terrain, leap across platforms, and uncover the facility's unsettling past — all while being hunted by eerie entities lurking just out of sight. Can You Survive And Uncover The Truth?...
